name: Tsunaman
summary: At Sun Rock Retreat, Tsunaman watches the currents of Kalimdor for signs of unrest. He works with the Horde against forces that threaten the waters.

sections.title: Agent of the Tides
sections.body: Near the path from Sun Rock Retreat down to the Charred Vale, Tsunaman serves the Tribunal of the Tides, high-ranking servants aligned with the Tidehunter, Neptulon. He works with the Horde to watch for elemental unrest throughout Kalimdor, especially disturbances spreading from the submerged caverns of Blackfathom Deeps.

sections.title: Hatred of Flame
sections.body: Tsunaman hates fire in every form. The burning lands of the Charred Vale and incursions by fire elementals keep him fuming. Around camp, he sometimes marches to nearby cooking fires and campfires and smacks them out with a heavy fist of water.

faq.answer: Tsunaman is a water elemental at Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. He serves the Tribunal of the Tides, watching elemental conflicts in Kalimdor and seeking aid against unnatural disturbances.

faq.q: Why does Tsunaman attack the campfire?
faq.answer: Tsunaman despises fire elementals and fire itself. At Sun Rock Retreat, he sometimes stomps over to travelers' campfires and extinguishes them with a watery strike.

faq.q: What is the Tribunal of the Tides?
faq.answer: The Tribunal of the Tides is an order of powerful elemental lieutenants aligned with Neptulon the Tidehunter, the Elemental Lord of water. They oversee aquatic domains and respond to disruptions in the world's waters.

faq.q: Why is Tsunaman interested in Blackfathom Deeps?
faq.answer: Blackfathom Deeps has been polluted by twilight cultists and dark forces that corrupt its native water spirits. Tsunaman enlists Horde adventurers to enter the sunken temple and quell the chaos in the waters.

angles.text: As a shaman seeking to understand and commune with the elements, you can speak directly with an emissary of the Tidehunter's court through Tsunaman.
As a member of the Horde, you can work with Tsunaman at Sun Rock Retreat against elemental imbalance and cultist intrusion in Kalimdor's waters.
